scope.description: Historical static export. The page described a broad ALS/MND-related condition search and embedded the drug, biological, and expanded-access candidates from that export. The exact ClinicalTrials.gov API query string was not stored on the page.

legacyPageBuckets.warning: mergedRecruitingLike adds RECRUITING, NOT_YET_RECRUITING, ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION, and AVAILABLE. It is not a count of recruiting trials. AVAILABLE is an expanded-access status.
legacyPageBuckets.warningZh: mergedRecruitingLike 把招募中、尚未招募、邀请入组和扩展使用状态 AVAILABLE 加在一起。它不是正在招募的试验数。AVAILABLE 属于扩展使用，不应算作普通招募中。
